thesis: Fundamentals behind the 11/05 earnings gap are strong (revenue +58% YoY, net income +27% YoY, ROE 23.3%, forward P/E 13.9). The stock is in a leading sector (XLF) with beta 0.244, so it is relatively shielded from the tech-led risk-off tape. The edge only exists on a pullback into the technical zone of 155.7-159.0: from the 157.35 midpoint, reward/risk to 174.0 against the 150.9 stop is about 2.6. At the 161.08 close it is about 1.3, which is below the 1.5 minimum. Conviction is capped at Overweight because RSI 75, a 12.4% extension above SMA20, price at the analyst mean target of 162.33, a risk-off regime and the missing news feed all argue for a smaller position.
invalidation: A daily close below 150.9 (under the 11/06 post-gap low of 151.52) invalidates the setup, and a close below the pre-gap close of 144.04 fully reverses the earnings breakout.
key_risks: Entry is valid only inside 155.7-159.0; buying at the 161.08 close gives reward/risk of about 1.3, under the 1.5 minimum
